subject: Novus Financial - Trust Framework Questionnaire and evidence sprint
messages:
From: Anna Perez <anna.perez@novusfin.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novusfin.com
Date: 2027-04-15T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Novus Trust Framework Questionnaire (SOC2/ISO)

Hi Chloe,

Thanks for taking this — attached is our Trust Framework Questionnaire (SOC 2 + ISO overlap) that we run for platform vendors. Key asks:
- A control mapping (your control IDs -> our questionnaire item IDs)
- Evidence for controls called out in sections 2, 4 and 7 (encryption, access mgmt, change control)
- A copy of the latest SOC 2 Type II report or a SOC bridge if not available

We'd like the mapping and a first pass at artifacts within 5 business days and to schedule a 60-minute walkthrough the week after. If you have any questions about scope, call out what you need.

Attached: Novus_Trust_Questionnaire_20270415.pdf (questionnaire)

Best,
Anna Perez
Senior Procurement Manager
Novus Financial
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novus Trust Framework Questionnaire (SOC2/ISO)

Team — forwarding Novus' questionnaire (attached). Quick triage and owners:

- Karthik: control mapping (questionnaire IDs -> Redwood control IDs), include references to SOC2/ISO sections and where we demonstrate (e.g., runbooks, config, telemetry).
- Jasmine: artifact collection + redaction plan, index CSV of artifacts we can hand over, and a secure delivery method.
- Marissa: legal review for anything in the questionnaire that impacts contractual commitments (retention, access to telemetry).

Deliverables timeline: first-pass mapping + artifact index by 2027-04-20 (EOD PDT). Finalized packet and meeting deck by 2027-04-22. Novus asked for a 60-minute walkthrough the following week — propose Wed 2027-04-28 10:00-11:00 PDT unless there are schedule conflicts.

Notes: avoid sending raw logs that contain customer data; use samples and sanitized screenshots. If an artifact requires redaction, flag it in the index and provide a sanitized sample and a path to produce the full item under NDA if necessary.

Attachments: Novus_Trust_Questionnaire_20270415.pdf

Thanks — I'll coordinate the calendar once we have availability.

Chloe Martin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T13:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novus Trust Framework Questionnaire (SOC2/ISO)

Chloe — starting the mapping now. Attached is draft_control_map_novus.xlsx (workbook contains a tab per questionnaire section). High level notes:

- Many of the Novus items map directly to our SOC2 control families (CC1-CC7 equivalents). I added a column with the artifact type (policy, runbook, screenshot, S3 export, config file).
- For encryption-at-rest / key management: we'll point them to KMS integration docs and provide a key rotation excerpt + KMS policy snippet.
- For telemetry/observability controls: recommend sending aggregated traces and sanitized agent configs; production PII excluded.
- Change control: attach the release playbook excerpt (we can reference a redacted runbook).

Question: Novus asked for evidence for section 7 change control. Do we include a short history export from our release registry (internal) or provide a sanitized release log? The registry contains commit SHAs that cross-reference customer-facing change notes; we should sanitize.

Attaching: control_map_novus.xlsx (DRAFT)

Karthik
Applied ML / Security Liaison, Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novus Trust Framework Questionnaire (SOC2/ISO)

Thanks Karthik — saw the draft map. Logistics update and artifact plan: 

1) Artifact index: I've started an index (artifact_index.csv) listing artifact_id, owner, type, recommended redaction, and transfer method. Will attach that to this thread.
2) Artifacts we can provide immediately (sanitized):
   - KMS policy excerpt (pdf)
   - KMS rotation log (sanitized CSV)
   - Release playbook excerpt (pdf)
   - Sample telemetry aggregates (json) — no user data
3) Artifacts that require controlled transfer / additional approvals:
   - Internal release registry export (requires legal approval and further sanitization)
   - Production configuration snapshots (sensitive)

Transfer options: secure S3 presigned links (preferred) or controlled upload to Novus' secure portal. I can prepare a password-protected ZIP (artifact_samples.zip) with sanitized samples for the initial package and then stage any sensitive docs to a signed S3 bucket once Marissa signs off.

Proposed cadence: send initial package (artifact_samples.zip + control_map_novus.xlsx + artifact_index.csv) by EOD 2027-04-20; secure items staged by 2027-04-21 after legal completes review.

Calendar: Wed 2027-04-28 10:00 PDT works for me. Chloe, if you want me to spin up the demo deck, I can take that on.

Attachments: artifact_index.csv, artifact_samples.zip (sanitized sample bundle)

—Jasmine
Technical Program Manager, Redwood Inference
